instruction: For turn count, lap direction, length_km, and approx_direction, prefer this file over Track_Riding_KB_AllTracks_v1.md or legacy JSON packs. Coaching bias lives in TRACK_SPECIFIC_DIAGNOSTIC_AU_v1.json. Rider-facing corner names must use turn number + rider-view left/right (never echo map_zone compass language such as top-left / bottom-right).

meta.direction_note: Wikipedia / official sources confirm CLOCKWISE. GPX bearing-change algorithm reads CCW (L=552 R=425 on 596-pt segment) — this is a known artefact: the long high-speed left-hand sweeps on the mountain descent (Conrod, Forrest's Elbow, The Dipper) accumulate more bearing-change events than the shorter rights, flipping the net count. Trust official source: clockwise. Same artefact occurs at SMP.
meta.elevation_note: Significant elevation; climbs to summit (Skyline, The Dipper) then descends Conrod Straight. Compression/rebound setup differs from flat circuits.
